description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes related to managing network connections in the lighttpd server, including connection states, socket callbacks, and IO handling.

classes.name: liConnection
classes.description: Represents a network connection, including state, buffers, and associated request and server info.

classes.name: liConnectionSocket
classes.description: Encapsulates socket data and callbacks for a connection.

classes.name: liConnectionSimpleTcpState
classes.description: Holds state information for simple TCP connections.

methods.name: li_connection_reset
methods.description: Resets a connection, closing it for keep-alive timeout.

methods.name: li_connection_update_io_wait
methods.description: Updates IO wait status for a connection.

methods.name: li_connection_error
methods.description: Aborts an active connection and calls cleanup handlers.

methods.name: li_connection_start
methods.description: Starts a connection with specified remote address and socket.

methods.name: li_connection_state_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a connection state.

methods.name: li_connection_from_vrequest
methods.description: Retrieves the connection associated with a virtual request.

methods.name: li_connection_request_done
methods.description: Marks the request as done after IO send operations.

methods.name: li_connection_update_io_timeout
methods.description: Updates IO timeout for a connection.

methods.name: li_connection_simple_tcp
methods.description: Handles IO stream events for a simple TCP connection.

methods.name: li_connection_http_new
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP connection for a socket.

methods.name: li_connection_simple_tcp_init
methods.description: Initializes the simple TCP connection state.
